create_seven_scenes_dataset: create a SevenScenes dataset instance with custom num_seq, num_frames, and ROOT path parameters
load_seven_scenes_tuples: load pre-defined scene tuples from a file path using the load_all_tuples method
get_seven_scenes_views: get RGB images, depthmaps, and camera poses for a sequence using the _get_views method
load_seven_scenes_split: load all scenes from a train or test split directory using the load_all_scenes method
